messages:
elena: Hi payroll team — my year-end packet shows a US W-2 with state withholding for CA and a UK P60 that also shows PAYE on the same earnings for Jan-Feb 2026. I was on a 3-month split-location assignment (CA -> UK -> CA). I'm worried I'm being double taxed. Any guidance?
hr_payroll: Thanks for raising this @elena. Can you DM your W-2 preview, P60, and dates/location log? Don't post NI/SSN here. We'll loop in Global Tax.
elena: DM'ed the docs and the travel approval emails.
payroll-bot: Payroll batch #202612 processed for 2026-12-31; year-end docs generated.
payroll_ops: Quick note: split-location assignments can create overlapping withholding if payroll and international payroll runs both captured the same service period. We need to map pay periods to payroll jurisdiction and check for tax treaty/relief application.
global_tax: Hi @elena — initial questions: 1) Were you on UK payroll (onshore) while physically in the UK, or paid via expense/temporary stipend? 2) Did you submit a UK tax code or claim treaty relief at the time? Those determine whether PAYE was correct or recoverable.
elena: I was onboarded to local UK payroll for Feb 2026 (paid in GBP), then transferred back to US payroll in March. No treaty claim submitted proactively.
finance_ops: If both jurisdictions withheld for the same gross, options: 1) request refund from HMRC for PAYE if employment was not UK taxable (via P50/P50Z or PAYE reclaim) 2) reclassify US wages for the overlapping period if they were not US-sourced 3) consider foreign tax credit on US return. We'll need exact pay dates and currency conversions.
hr_payroll: Plan: 1) Payroll Ops will create a mapping of service days vs payroll runs (US vs UK) 2) If duplicate withholding occurred, Payroll Ops + Global Tax will coordinate HMRC reclaim and US adjustment 3) Finance will prepare payroll credit/refund mechanics if reclaim succeeds or process employee gross-up if needed 4) We'll aim to update you in 7 business days.
elena: Appreciate the plan. One practical ask — will refunds come through payroll or as separate HMRC checks? I'm overseas part-time and banking is a mix.
global_tax: Ordinarily HMRC refunds go directly to the taxpayer's UK bank account or by cheque; if employer facilitated PAYE reclaim we can request HMRC credit to employer and have payroll issue a refund via payroll (preferred for simpler US tax handling). We'll confirm approach after verifying the reclaim eligibility.
payroll_ops: Action items assigned. We'll extract the Feb payroll ledger, confirm GBP payments and conversion dates, and check whether US payroll also captured Feb gross.
payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-2026-612 created: "Multi-jurisdiction withholding review — Elena" (linked to thread 1799901234). Sensitive docs stored in People Ops secure bucket; access limited to payroll/legal/people-ops/global-tax.
finance_ops: Note: if we refund via payroll, tax reporting implications vary — we may need to issue corrected W-2 or a payroll supplement. We'll coordinate with Tax to minimize employee filing burden.
elena: Thanks everyone — I'll watch this thread and provide any extra docs if needed. Really appreciate the help :pray:
